## Do not cite / private

Authenticated management panels (`/admin`, `/manager`, `/teacher`, `/student`, and related role roots), auth utility pages (`/auth/*`), invite-only forms (`/f/*`, `/register/guest/*`), and admin-gated `/life` are not public content.

- Public brand name: Etkan
